phase_name: Strict-mode migration batch A (highest-risk state mutators)

objectives.note: Found and fixed 2 -e-hostile VAR=$(cmd) assignments (dry-run and real transform branches) that would have silently short-circuited past the documented exit-3 error message under -e. Fixed via the standard `VAR=$(cmd) || status=$?` guard. Verified with a live mktemp-fixture exercise (valid write, dry-run valid, dry-run invalid filter exit 3, real invalid filter exit 3 with file left untouched) plus test-state-write-concurrency.sh (9/9) and test-state-write-regen-timing.sh (3/3), both green. Committed separately (task 988 phase 6.1).

Audited: 1644 lines with dozens of unguarded `VAR=$(jq/ps/stat ...)` assignments feeding a concurrency-critical mutex (e.g. resolve_task_dir's project_name lookup, read_holder_field's many call sites, session-registry reads). Several are documented as intentional graceful-degradation-on-failure paths (see resolve_task_dir's and get_file_scope's header comments), meaning a bare set -e flip would convert an intended fallback into an abrupt abort. A correct fix requires guarding each site individually with the same VAR=$(cmd) || ... pattern used in state-write.sh, then re-exercising test-task-lock-reap.sh plus a live concurrent-acquire fixture. Deliberately deferred to a follow-up dispatch with a full context budget rather than rushed.

approaches_tried.approach: Full -e-hostility audit of task-lock.sh in this same dispatch
approaches_tried.reason: File is 1644 lines with dozens of hazard sites in a concurrency-critical mutex script; correctness risk of a rushed pass outweighs finishing the batch in one dispatch. See objective 2 note.

deviations.description: Migrate task-lock.sh, git-commit-scoped.sh, orchestrate-batch-admit.sh, orchestrate-predispatch-review.sh in this dispatch
deviations.reason: Context/time budget for this dispatch was better spent completing state-write.sh correctly (with a full audit and live fixture exercise) than rushing four more files, one of which (task-lock.sh) is the highest-blast-radius file in the whole plan.
